main_text.p: damentum. Plur. [Hebrew], Syr. [Syriac] Fundamenta, Lucæ 6.48. Cum Aff. [Hebrew] Fundamenta ejus, Psalm. 24. 2. [Hebrew] Fundamenta eorum, Jobi 4.19.

[Hebrew] Ch. Sociavit, associavit, consociavit, conjunxit, Psalm. 69.10. Pahel [Hebrew] Idem, Cant. 1.1. Syr. [Syriac] Communicabat, Act. 7.61. Ithpah, [Hebrew] Prover. 5.17. [Hebrew] Esth. 3.14. in Targ. sec. [Syriac] Syr. Consociari, conjungi, conjungere, adjungere, associare se, consentire, communicare, participem esse.
[Syriac] Ch. [Syriac] Syr. Societas, amicitia, sodalitium, commercium, communicatio.

[Hebrew] Ch. & Syr. Tacuit, conticuit, siluit. Aph [Hebrew] Idem, 1. Sam. 7.8. Pahel [Syriac] Silere fecit, Silentium imposuit, Matth. 22.34. Partic. [Hebrew] Silebant, Ezech. 1.24. Ethpah. [Syriac] Obmutuit, Matth. 22.12. Fut. [Syriac] Obmutescent, silebunt, 1. ad Corinth. 13.8. Sic Ch. [Hebrew] conticescent, Exod. 15.16. in Targ. Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee script is transcribed only approximately as placeholders; the exact Hebrew and Syriac letters are not reliably legible at this scan resolution. Pointed Syriac forms are unclear in several places.
